The Subtask Name: Identify the correct Wikipedia page for Real Time with Bill Maher Season 16

- Agent: Planner

  -- Observation: WebSurfer returned a DuckDuckGo search page with a link to the Wikipedia page for "Real Time with Bill Maher season 16".
  -- Thought: The search results contain the correct Wikipedia URL. To get the exact premiere date, I need to open that specific page directly.
  -- Result: Decided to instruct WebSurfer to open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real_Time_with_Bill_Maher_season_16.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Navigated to the Wikipedia page for Real Time with Bill Maher Season 16.
  -- Observation: The page displayed the "Release" section showing "Original release: January 19 – November 16, 2018" and the "Episodes" table listing Episode 1 with the date "January 19, 2018".
  -- Thought: The Wikipedia page explicitly states the season started on January 19, 2018. This is the premiere date.
  -- Result: Extracted the date January 19, 2018 from the page content.
